skills.title: Orphex Account Structure Audit
skills.description: Audit supplied campaign and ad-group structure, naming, budget ownership, targeting overlap, and settings to rank verifiable risks and outline an approval-ready cleanup plan.
skills.outcome: A ranked account-structure audit with evidence-linked operational risks, bounded performance implications, a staged cleanup plan, approvals, and rollback mapping.
requirements: Topology export with stable entity IDs, parent relationships, statuses, budget ownership, targeting, and relevant settings
Naming rules and campaign objectives; matched performance periods and change history for impact or timing claims

skills.title: Orphex Anomaly Investigation
skills.description: Investigate sudden marketing spend, CPA, ROAS, or conversion shifts from supplied evidence, rank testable causes, and state uncertainty and next checks.
skills.outcome: A ranked anomaly assessment with comparable metric movement, falsifiable causes, confidence, evidence gaps, and next checks.
requirements: User-supplied metric numerator and denominator, comparison period, and source definition

skills.title: Orphex Budget Change Proposal
skills.description: Prepare a quantified marketing budget change proposal from supplied performance data, including portfolio arithmetic, forecast limits, and a clear approval boundary.
skills.outcome: A reviewable budget proposal with per-campaign deltas, portfolio impact, assumptions, risks, and an explicit approval boundary.
requirements: User-supplied budgets, performance exports, or planning documents

skills.title: Orphex Campaign Budget Reallocator
skills.description: Propose a fixed-total budget reallocation across campaigns using efficiency evidence, volume, headroom, bounds, and explicit approval limits.
skills.outcome: A feasible fixed-total allocation with reconciled deltas, evidence, bounded impact estimates, and an approval boundary.
requirements: User-supplied fixed total, current campaign allocations, and applicable bounds or protected amounts

skills.title: Orphex Conversion Tracking Health Check
skills.description: Audit supplied conversion-tracking configuration and event diagnostics for missing, duplicated, or malformed signals without assuming report totals should match.
skills.outcome: A privacy-safe event-path assessment with pass, fail, not-tested, or unknown findings and scoped verification steps.
requirements: Expected event definition plus a safe configuration view, diagnostic, or reproducible test path

skills.title: Orphex Creative Fatigue Detector
skills.description: Assess creative fatigue from comparable delivery-age, reach, frequency, CTR, CPM, and objective-specific outcome trends, then rank refresh priorities with evidence, confidence limits, and caveats.
skills.outcome: A ranked creative fatigue assessment that distinguishes supported decline, watch signals, no observed signal, and unknowns, with a bounded refresh test.
requirements: Stable creative or ad IDs, campaign objective, optimization event, and reporting dates
Creative-level delivery trends including impressions, clicks, spend, and objective outcomes; reach/frequency and first-delivery or change history when available

skills.title: Orphex Creative Signal Review
skills.description: Review paid creative results against the campaign objective and delivery context, separating early signals from evidence strong enough to guide a next test.
skills.outcome: A creative comparison grounded in the stated objective, comparable delivery, observed metrics, and a concrete next test.
requirements: User-supplied creative-level delivery or outcome data and the campaign objective

skills.title: Orphex Geo & Device Breakdown Analysis
skills.description: Analyze supplied location and device breakdowns across aligned periods to identify durable differences, preserve overlapping dimensions, and propose evidence-bounded targeting or bid checks.
skills.outcome: An aligned location/device analysis with weighted aggregate metrics, overlap and lag caveats, confidence-bounded segment rankings, and supported next checks.
requirements: Location and device/OS breakdowns with consistent reporting periods, account timezone, currency, campaign scope, and dimension definitions
Impressions, clicks, spend, and conversion/value fields when available, with event and attribution definitions; current targeting and bid strategy for change suggestions

skills.title: Orphex Impression Share & Auction Insights Review
skills.description: Review supplied Search or Performance Max impression-share and Auction Insights data to distinguish budget, rank, and competitor-overlap signals.
skills.outcome: A scope-aware delivery review that preserves metric denominators and availability limits, separates budget from rank loss, and frames missed impressions without profit forecasts.
requirements: Campaign-type and network-specific impression-share and loss metrics
Auction Insights rows where available, preserving entity and segment scope
Business outcome definition, currency, and conversion-lag context for economic interpretation

skills.title: Orphex Keyword Mining on Search Terms
skills.description: Mine supplied Search terms for converting or high-intent demand that may merit keyword coverage, with evidence-ranked candidates and eligibility checks.
skills.outcome: A ranked, reviewable set of keyword test candidates with observed query evidence, current-coverage checks, suggested match types, ad-group fit, and explicit uncertainty.
requirements: Search terms export with dates, matched keyword, scope, and available outcome metrics
Current keyword inventory and match types for coverage assessment
Negative keywords and campaign eligibility details when available

skills.title: Orphex Landing Conversion Review
skills.description: Review supplied landing-page and funnel evidence to locate conversion friction, distinguish observed patterns from causes, and propose measurable next checks.
skills.outcome: A funnel review that identifies observed drop-offs, relevant segment differences, evidence gaps, and testable page hypotheses.
requirements: User-supplied page evidence, funnel exports, or both

skills.title: Orphex Measurement Consistency Check
skills.description: Reconcile marketing metric and event definitions across supplied reports so apparent differences are explained by scope before being treated as tracking failures.
skills.outcome: A source-by-source reconciliation of event, denominator, attribution, time, currency, and identity rules with bounded findings.
requirements: User-supplied reports, event definitions, or measurement documentation

skills.title: Orphex Placement Cleaning
skills.description: Review supplied ad placement and inventory reports to separate brand suitability from efficiency, quantify observable spend at stake, and propose verified, scoped exclusions for display, video, and Performance Max inventory.
skills.outcome: A scoped placement review that separates suitability from efficiency, quantifies only observed spend, and presents verified exclusions with coverage and confidence limits.
requirements: Placement or where-shown export with identity, type, impressions, reporting period, and campaign context
Cost and outcome fields when available; advertiser suitability rules and supported exclusion scopes for an exclusion proposal

skills.title: Orphex PMax Asset Group & Search Themes Audit
skills.description: Audit supplied Performance Max asset groups, search themes, audience signals, and Search overlap for evidence-backed coverage and structure recommendations.
skills.outcome: A campaign-aware audit of PMax group, asset, URL, theme, and Search-overlap evidence that separates platform signals from targeting controls and causal conclusions.
requirements: PMax campaign and asset-group inventory with URLs, assets, themes, and signals
Campaign-level outcomes with conversion definitions and date range
Search insights and Search campaign controls when overlap is assessed

skills.title: Orphex Quality Score Reviewer
skills.description: Review supplied Search keyword Quality Score components and group actionable patterns by business exposure rather than score averages.
skills.outcome: A diagnostic review of keyword-level expected CTR, ad relevance, and landing-page experience patterns, tied to business exposure and testable follow-up hypotheses.
requirements: Keyword-level current or historical Quality Score and component statuses
Aligned keyword, campaign, ad-group, and performance rows
Conversion definition and window for business-exposure prioritization

skills.title: Orphex RSA Ad Copy & Asset Review
skills.description: Review supplied responsive Search ad assets for keep, replace, pin, and copy-test proposals grounded in query, offer, and asset evidence.
skills.outcome: An asset-by-asset RSA review with directional performance evidence, approved-claim sourcing, pinning risk, and clearly labeled copy-test proposals.
requirements: RSA asset export with asset IDs, text, type, pin/status, and date range
Ad-level totals and named conversion definition
Approved product claims, offers, brand voice, and legal wording for copy drafts

skills.title: Orphex Search Term Cleaning
skills.description: Review supplied Search terms to separate irrelevant spend from relevant demand and prepare scoped, risk-aware negative keyword proposals.
skills.outcome: An evidence-linked negative keyword proposal that protects converting and relevant queries, states historical spend exposure, and makes match-type and scope risks reviewable.
requirements: Search terms export with dates, scope, cost, and available conversion metrics
Brand/protected-query definitions
Negative keyword inventory and scope when exclusion proposals are needed

skills.title: Orphex Weekly Performance Review
skills.description: Review weekly or monthly marketing performance from supplied exports and documents, aligning comparison periods, metric definitions, currency, and attribution limits.
skills.outcome: A concise period-over-period review with comparable metrics, evidence-linked explanations, uncertainty, and prioritized next actions.
requirements: User-supplied marketing performance exports or documents with a reporting period

skills.title: Orphex Weekly Performance Summarizer
skills.description: Summarize supplied weekly marketing results into a concise stakeholder update with comparable metrics, evidence-backed movement, caveats, and the next useful action.
skills.outcome: A concise, evidence-linked weekly update with correctly aggregated metrics, confidence, caveats, and prioritized next actions.
requirements: User-supplied reporting period, source, and an objective-linked metric with its numerator and denominator
